name: MEMCOMPILER_BOUNDED_SELECTION_TRACE_INSTRUMENTATION
purpose: Make the existing fixed-candidate-pool ScienceWorld mechanism replayable enough to support later fixed-selected-identity acceptance experiments, without putting raw memory contents into the receiver context.

capture: compiler model artifact id and immutable revision/digest
capture_points.reason: bind evaluated implementation/model/input/memory bytes before retrieval

capture: stable memory_id + content_sha256 for every candidate
capture_points.reason: prove candidate pool identity without replaying raw memory into downstream context

capture_points.when: immediately after every Manager/compiler call and before Executor input
capture: selected memory ids/digests or empty set
capture_points.reason: distinguish selected identity from final injection/abstention and permit causal pairing

bounded_context_rule: Persist raw memory text only in the existing memory store, not in the sidecar. The sidecar carries stable IDs/digests; normal executor context receives only compiled guidance when injected.
compatibility_with_existing_protocol: The trace supplies the missing evidence needed by memory_selection_trace_binding_v1 to distinguish fixed_candidate_pool_state_conditioned from fixed_selected_identity_acceptance claims.
fail_closed_conditions: memory database is not frozen during evaluation
candidate pool digest changes within an episode
selected memory id/digest is not a member of the frozen pool
NOACTION carries selected memory or compiled guidance
EXPERIENCE/HYBRID lacks selected identity or compiled guidance digest
selector output digest does not match the recorded selected identities/output type/guidance digest
